$description: Webflow's standard breakpoint set plus two root-font-size-only stops. Counts are occurrences of each @media width condition across ALL THREE CSS sources: src/styles/fourmula-base.css, src/styles/fourmula-head.css and the inline <style> block inside src/components/Footer.jsx.
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.

breakpoint.tablet.role: Primary layout switch: the type scale drops a tier, the hero slider marquee flips from vertical to horizontal, the menu panel resizes.

breakpoint.mobile.role: Second type tier, dots-field dot size drops 1rem -> 0.5rem.

breakpoint.mobile-small.role: Smallest Webflow tier. No type-scale change; layout-only adjustments.

breakpoint.desktop-min.role: Sets the hero slider marquee axis to vertical (--tx/--ty custom properties).

breakpoint.tablet-min.role: Two uses: Webflow lightbox CSS in fourmula-base.css, and the dots-field 1rem dot size in Footer.jsx's inline <style>.

breakpoint.root-2560.role: Root font-size stop ONLY. No layout rule uses it.

breakpoint.root-1728.role: Root font-size stop ONLY. No layout rule uses it.

jsBreakpoints.$description: public/motion/m07.js rebuilds the footer dots field at its OWN breakpoints, which are min-width thresholds in JS, not CSS queries.

correctionToGroundwork: An earlier count gave 991px=5, 767px=4, 479px=4, min-768px=1. Re-counting across all three CSS sources gives 767px=5 and min-width:768px=2: the inline <style> block inside src/components/Footer.jsx adds one of each for the dots field. 991px=5, 479px=4 and min-width:992px=1 are confirmed unchanged.
